verdict.rationale: Shopify Agentic Commerce's entire evidenced role is as an MCP *server* provider (Global Catalog, Storefront Catalog, Cart, Checkout, Order MCP servers) that other agents consume — not as an agent or host that itself plugs in and calls third-party MCP servers' tools. No evidence shows Shopify's platform acting as an MCP client consuming external servers; this is a category mismatch analogous to the reverse of the agent/server-role exception, so the client-side 'plug in MCP servers' story does not apply to this product.
